Name: Rajiv Goel
Bio: Rajiv Goel is a Founder of Plaksha University. Rajiv Goel is the Executive Director of Havells. He has been associated with Havells for 12 years prior to which he has worked in FirstRand Bank, Reliance Capital and PriceWaterhouse Coopers. He is a Chartered Accountant (Gold medalist) and has completed his Bachelor's from Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University.
Education: BCom (Hons), Commerce, Shri Ram College of Commerce
